summary: FiscalNote Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing amended forbearance agreements with subordinated creditors GPO FN Noteholder and YA II PN, extending waivers on defaults from the delisting of its Class A common stock from the NYSE. The amendments push the forbearance period to July 21, 2026, during which creditors agree not to exercise remedies. This reflects ongoing financial distress and restructuring efforts. No price, premium, or consideration was involved. Watch for potential equity dilution or conversion triggers on the subordinated convertible debt if forbearance ends without a resolution.
